what_happened: A person used Grok Bot to track and report website traffic using Lnkgo. They set up a bot to shorten URLs, track analytics, and report traffic KPIs. The bot was configured to fetch analytics for active campaign links and send a daily or weekly digest.

evidence.note: Public Grok Bot setup captured from a directory listing.
